# Site for sale

> A one acre site located in the townland of Gortnagrace. Presently laid out as a rectangular shaped, good quality grassland field which has extensive road frontage onto a peaceful, minor public road. Gently sloping with a west-facing aspect, the plot offers commanding rural views over the Finn Valley. Located almost midway between the towns of Castlefin (5km) and Castlederg (4km).

## Fakta
- Typ: site
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Lokalita: Gortnagrace, Castlefin
- Cena: 45 000 €
